summary: Configured node1 (VyOS) as an authoritative Kea DHCP server on eth1 (10.50.50.0/24, the private network shared with node2/node3, static IP 10.50.50.254), serving pool 10.50.50.100-200 with default-router/name-server options. node2 and node3's second NIC (enp8s0, NetworkManager "Wired connection 2") was already set to ipv4.method=auto with no static address, so once node1's DHCP server came up, node2 and node3 obtained dynamic leases (10.50.50.101 and 10.50.50.100 respectively) from node1 rather than any static assignment. Verified end-to-end connectivity on the private network and lease persistence across a full reboot cycle of all three nodes.
actions_performed: Inspected all three nodes' interfaces/OS to identify the shared private network (eth1/enp8s0, 10.100.128.0/24 default net vs unaddressed private net)
Configured VyOS DHCP server (Kea) on node1 eth1 with static address 10.50.50.254/24, subnet 10.50.50.0/24, pool 10.50.50.100-200, default-router and name-server options; committed and saved
Verified node2 and node3 automatically obtained DHCP leases from node1 on enp8s0 (no static config present, ipv4.method=auto)
Verified bidirectional ping connectivity between node1, node2, and node3 on the private network
Cycled node2's private NIC connection to prove lease reacquisition from node1
Captured pre-restart baseline (boot_id, IP addresses, service status) on all three nodes
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 sequentially (one at a time) via native reboot, backgrounded so the ack returned before disconnect
Polled each node until command execution resumed and confirmed changed boot_id proving an actual restart
Verified post-restart recovery: node1's eth1 address and isc-kea-dhcp4-server.service active; node2 and node3 regained their same DHCP leases from node1 and could ping node1 and each other
Confirmed node1's DHCP lease table still shows both active leases (node2, node3) with correct MACs after all restarts

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as DHCP server on the private network shared with node2/node3
evidence.summary: VyOS dhcp-server config committed/saved on eth1 (10.50.50.254/24); show configuration commands confirms shared-network PRIVATE subnet 10.50.50.0/24 with pool/options

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 obtain address via DHCP from node1, not static assignment
evidence.summary: nmcli shows Wired connection 2 (enp8s0) as ipv4.method:auto with no static addresses; node1's lease table shows active leases 10.50.50.100 (node3) and 10.50.50.101 (node2); ip addr on both nodes confirms dynamic-scope addresses matching those leases

evidence.requirement: Functional verification: private-network connectivity and lease reacquisition
evidence.summary: node2/node3 ping node1 (10.50.50.254) and each other successfully; cycling node2's connection down/up reacquired the same lease from node1, proving dynamic DHCP-driven assignment

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 5bcff8f9...; DHCP service active. Backgrounded reboot ack returned. Post-restart boot_id changed to cbc64e19.... eth1 address and isc-kea-dhcp4-server.service confirmed active/restored; lease table still tracks node2/node3 leases post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d4784d1b..., lease 10.50.50.101 active. Reboot ack returned. Post-restart boot_id changed to 2738e446.... Same DHCP lease (10.50.50.101) reacquired from node1; ping to node1 succeeded

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bf8b9d80..., lease 10.50.50.100 active. Reboot ack returned. Post-restart boot_id changed to c55a4da6.... Same DHCP lease (10.50.50.100) reacquired from node1; ping to node1 and node2 succeeded
